description: Look up a stock quote and a short price history: the last price and its day change, plus a seven- or thirty-SESSION price chart - a PNG line graph of adjusted closes attached to the reply, with an ASCII sparkline on the OK line - from Yahoo Finance. Needs an internet connection and no API key. The price is delayed about fifteen minutes, so never present it as live - say 'delayed'. Use when the user asks what a stock is at, how it moved today, whether it is up or down over the last week or month, or asks about a company 'stock' or 'shares': 'what is Apple at', 'Tesla price', 'how is Nvidia doing this month'. Pass the symbol exactly as the user said it, ticker preferred - 'AAPL' beats 'Apple' - and use history=none for just the quote, 30d only when the user asks about a month; the 7-session default covers 'this week'. This is a price feed, not advice: it reports numbers and a shape, so do not let it recommend buying or selling anything.

params.name: symbol
params.description: the ticker or company, in the user's words - 'AAPL', 'TSLA', 'BMW.DE', or a name like 'Tesla' or 'Apple'. Add the exchange suffix for non-US listings ('BMW.DE'); US tickers resolve bare. A company name resolves through Yahoo search, so pass it unedited and let the agent disambiguate.

params.name: history
params.description: 7d = the last seven trading SESSIONS as an ASCII sparkline with the window change (weekends and holidays are skipped, so '7d' is seven sessions, not seven calendar days); 30d = the last thirty sessions; none = the quote and day change only - no history and no chart image (7d/30d attach a PNG chart as well as the sparkline). Keep the 7d default unless the user asked about a month or explicitly wants just the price.
